headline_events.title: Exploited Outlook Zero-Day Among 1,094 Flaws Patched by Microsoft

headline_events.title: Ransomware recovery is now a client retention metric
headline_events.title_zh: 勒索軟體復原現已成為客戶留存率指標
headline_events.summary: Recovering from ransomware doesn't guarantee an MSP will retain its clients, especially when delays, poor communication, and unexpected costs undermine trust. Kaseya examines how disconnected recovery tools create these problems and how integrated workflows can improve response times, transparency, and client retention. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: 從勒索軟體攻擊中復原並不能保證 MSP 能夠留住客戶，特別是在延遲、溝通不良以及意料之外的成本損害信任的情況下。Kaseya 探討了未整合的復原工具如何引發這些問題，以及整合工作流程如何能改善應變時間、透明度與客戶留存率。[...]

headline_events.title: Vanderbilt University hit in BYOD ransomware attack, data theft claimed

headline_events.summary: Vanderbilt University warns it is responding to a cyberattack claimed by the BYOD ransomware gang, which claims to have encrypted the university's databases and stolen sensitive student, employee, and research data. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: 范德堡大學（Vanderbilt University）警告稱正因應一起網路攻擊，聲稱指控來自 BYOD 勒索軟體犯罪集團，該集團聲稱已加密該大學的資料庫並竊取敏感的學生、員工及研究資料。[...]

facts.title: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
facts.title_zh: Google Chromium 釋放後重用（Use-After-Free）漏洞
facts.description: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
facts.description_zh: Google Chromium 的 XML 元件中存在釋放後重用（Use-After-Free）漏洞，可允許遠端攻擊者透過特製的網頁在沙盒內執行任意程式碼。此漏洞可能會影響多個使用 Chromium 的網頁瀏覽器，包含但不限於 Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge 與 Opera。

facts.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

facts.title: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
facts.title_zh: Barracuda Networks 多款產品作業系統命令注入漏洞
facts.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606
facts.description_zh: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG)、Load Balancer、Application Delivery Controller (ADC)、Message Archiver (BMA)、WAF Control Center (WCC)、Web Application Firewall (WAF) 與 Web Security Gateway (WSG) 存在作業系統命令注入漏洞。當隨後處理特製的時區值時，此漏洞可允許經身分驗證的管理者注入以 root 權限執行的作業系統命令。此漏洞可與 CVE-2026-116606 鏈結利用。

facts.description: mailcow: dockerized before 2026-11 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows domain administrators to execute commands in the shared rspamd container by storing a malicious domain-wide footer. Attackers can embed a Jinja macro with an os.execute default value, rendered by the rspamd MOO_FOOTER prefilter, to read or inject mail for every tenant and disable filtering.

rabbitmq-c is a C-language AMQP client library for RabbitMQ. Prior to version 0.17.0, the bounds check (*offset = o + len) <= encoded.len overflows when o + len > SIZE_MAX on 32-bit systems. len is a uint32_t read from the AMQP wire as a BYTES/UTF8 field length. The overflow wraps the check to a small value that passes, producing a decoded amqp_bytes_t with a multi-GB .len pointing into a small frame buffer. This results in an out-of-bounds read of up to ~4GB of process memory on 32-bit systems (ARM, MIPS, x86 ILP32, embedded IoT AMQP clients). Enabling information disclosure or denial of service. Not exploitable on 64-bit systems where size_t is 64-bit. This issue has been patched in version 0.17.0.

U.S. Geological Survey Area Species Management Research Program (ARMI) accepts any uploaded file and stores the file under '/uploads/{upload-file}'. A remote, authenticated attacker could upload a crafted PHP file that executes and returns command output from the server when accessed. Fixed on 2026-07-20.
